annotation.title_clean: 北京市无人驾驶航空器特殊保障规定（试行）
annotation.title_en: Beijing Municipal Provisions on Special Support for Unmanned Aircraft (Trial)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 北京市公安局 (Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau)
annotation.venue: 北京市公安局 (京公无人机发〔2026〕287号)
named_instruments_referenced: 北京市无人驾驶航空器管理规定
annotation.summary_en: Beijing Public Security Bureau administrative rules, effective 15 Nov 2026, establishing list-based special support for purchasing, transporting and storing drones and core components for counter-terrorism, disaster relief, schools, research, production and agriculture, with layered approval, safety assessment and secure storage requirements. Replaces earlier March 2026 versions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Special support on a list basis for purchase, transport and storage of drones and core parts for specified uses (counter-terrorism, disaster relief, research, production, agriculture).
Applications must be vetted by superior authority, then safety-assessed and approved by Beijing Public Security Bureau.
Storage sites require independent rooms, Grade 3 anti-theft doors, 24-hour video monitoring (90-day retention) and logs kept 1 year.
Approved units must set up security management systems to prevent rental, lending, loss or theft.
Existing approvals not meeting criteria are cancelled and drones disposed of; effective 15 November 2026.
